title: Dunkl regularity over alternative $*$-algebras
summary: We characterise slice-regularity of functions over a real alternative *-algebra using operators that arise in Dunkl operator theory. We present a unifying perspective on hypercomplex analysis by defining a family of function spaces in the kernel of Dunkl-Cauchy-Riemann operators. Each of these function spaces, whose elements are called Dunkl-regular functions, refines Dunkl monogenic function theory and Dunkl harmonic analysis on Euclidean spaces.
